'''''Raymond Yip Wai-man''''' (葉偉民) is a film director from [[Hong Kong]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.allmovie.com/artist/raymond-yip-wai-man-p266510|title=Raymond Yip Wai Man|accessdate= 2012-02-16|work=allmovie.com|publisher=Rovi Corp}}</ref>

==Filmography==
=== Films ===
* 1993 The Kung Fu Cult Master - Assistant director.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.hkmdb.com/db/movies/view.mhtml?id=7706&display_set=eng |title=倚天屠龍記之魔教教主 (1993) Kung Fu Cult Master |website=hkmdb.com |date=December 18, 1993 |accessdate=October 8, 2020}}</ref>
* 1995 ''[[Sixty Million Dollar Man]]'' - Screenwriter, Director. 
* 1998 ''[[Portland Street Blues]]'' - Director.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://hkmdb.com/db/movies/view.mhtml?id=8333&display_set=eng |title=古惑仔情義篇之洪興十三妹 (1998) Portland Street Blues |website=hkmdb.com |date=February 21, 1998 |accessdate=October 8, 2020}}</ref>
* 2000 ''[[For Bad Boys Only]]'' 
* 2000 ''[[Those Were the Days... (2000 film)|Those Were the Days...]]''
* 2002 ''[[Beauty and the Breast]]'' 
* 2003 ''[[Anna in Kungfuland]]'' 
* 2010 ''[[Bruce Lee, My Brother]]''  
* 2010 ''[[Lost on Journey]]'' 
* 2012 ''[[Blood Stained Shoes]]'' 
* 2014 ''[[The House That Never Dies]]'' 
* 2015 ''[[Tales of Mystery (film)|Tales of Mystery]]'' 
* 2016 ''[[Phantom of the Theatre]]'' 
* 2017 ''[[Cook Up a Storm]]'' <ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.emp.hk/en/production/recent-hits/cook-up-a-storm |title=Cook Up a Storm |website=emp.hk |date=2017 |accessdate=October 9, 2020}}</ref>
